## 3. The SAME ordinary bank estimates one marginal and both contrasts

Condition on ANY correct coarse history. In every fine block prepare independent uniform X/Z axes and independent uniform signs on all q logical inputs, and measure every physical output in an independently uniform fresh Pauli basis. For the learned envelope W_i form the actual product shadow

    Z_(i,t)=tensor_(l in W_i)(3 Pi_(a_l,b_l)-I).

Retain the three Hermitian matrix records

    Y_(i,0,t)=Z_(i,t),
    Y_(i,j,t)=2*1{j_i=j}*s_i*Z_(i,t), j=X,Z.            (5)

The scalar 2 pays the input-axis probability. No incompatible measurements, cloned outputs, independent shadow samples or quantum calibration references are supplied. Correlated logical/site statistics are computations from the ONE actual full product record.

Given the entire PRIOR history, averaging every current input sign/axis and readout gives

    E Y_(i,0,t)=rho_(i,t),
    E Y_(i,j,t)=Delta_(i,j,t)=B_(i,j) R_(i,j,t),
    kappa rho_(i,t)<=R_(i,j,t)<=rho_(i,t),
    [B_(i,j),R_(i,j,t)]=[B_(i,j),rho_(i,t)]=0.          (6)

These are local reductions of the global source identities. Exact support allows B to pass through the outside trace. Most importantly the SAME rho_(i,t) occurs for BOTH j: the fresh random signs average the logical input to I/2 independently of its selected axis. One must not replace this schedule by deterministic axis cycling under a changing memory source.

For any finite bank, the random predictable averages satisfy EXACTLY

    Delta_bar_(i,j)=B_(i,j) Rbar_(i,j),
    Rbar_(i,j)>=kappa rho_bar_i,
    [B_(i,j),Rbar_(i,j)]=0.                            (7)

This uses the fixed B, not stationarity or iid gauge states. Thus if rho_bar_i>=r_i I, both true signed contrasts have a spectral gap at least kappa r_i about zero and sign(Delta_bar_(i,j))=B_(i,j).

## 4. Finite confidence stages without a supplied excitation number

Let b be the largest positive dyadic with

    b^2<=epsilon/(18Aq).                              (8)

Then b<=1/4 and b^2>epsilon/(72Aq). Fix

    L=ceil log2(6dq(S+1)/beta1),
    a_s=2^(-s)/(16d),
    N_s=ceil[8*3^W*L/a_s^2],  s=0,...,S.              (9)
